nodes.name: HTTP: Deliver to Downstream
nodes.notes: Retries are handled explicitly by the loop below (exponential backoff with jitter), so the node's built-in fixed-interval retry is off.

nodes.name: Alert: Generic Webhook
nodes.notes: Works with Slack/Teams incoming webhooks or any endpoint that accepts JSON.

nodes.name: Alert: Email (optional)
nodes.notes: Disabled by default. Add SMTP credentials and enable to get email alerts too.

parameters.content:
## Production-ready order intake (demo)
Webhook -> validate -> 202 -> deliver with **exponential backoff + jitter** -> alert on permanent failure.

Edit **Set Context & Config** after import. No secrets live in this workflow.
See README and docs/runbook.md.
